verdict: In winter 2022/23 (October to March), Germany's grid delivered 8.8% less electricity than the weather and calendar predicted (90% range 6.2% to 11.2%), about 23.1 TWh. Demand has NOT fully come back: in 2025/26 it was still 4.2% below the pre-crisis pattern (range 1.5% to 6.8%). Counting only dark hours (when rooftop solar can't hide demand), the 2022/23 saving was 9.2%.

official_check.note: Official figures as first published each January; SMARD values are revised later, so differences under about 1% are expected.
